calls.statement:
WITH web_sales AS (
  SELECT 
    f.sales_line_id,
    f.receipt_id,
    f.net_amount,
    f.quantity,
    CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date_helsinki,
    s.store_id,
    p.category,
    d.fiscal_year,
    d.fiscal_period,
    d.fiscal_period_label
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON f.receipt_id = o.web_order_id
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = d.calendar_date
  WHERE s.store_id = 900
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
),
web_returns AS (
  SELECT 
    r.sales_line_id,
    r.refund_net,
    d.fiscal_period
  FROM fact_return_line r
  LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT 
    ws.fiscal_year,
    ws.fiscal_period,
    ws.fiscal_period_label,
    SUM(ws.net_amount) as sales_net,
    SUM(COALESCE(wr.refund_net, 0)) as returns_net,
    SUM(ws.net_amount) - SUM(COALESCE(wr.refund_net, 0)) as net_sales
  FROM web_sales ws
  LEFT JOIN web_returns wr ON ws.sales_line_id = wr.sales_line_id
  GROUP BY ws.fiscal_year, ws.fiscal_period, ws.fiscal_period_label
)
SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  fiscal_period_label,
  ROUND(net_sales, 2) as net_sales
FROM net_lines
ORDER BY fiscal_period
